correctness.rationale: Surjectivity and back force the incidence-frame root to \(r\); forth forces every clause world to \(c\); sink structure forces every variable world to \(t\) or \(f\). Back at a clause is then exactly the not-all-equal condition, giving a literal bijection with monotone \(\operatorname{NAE}_3\) assignments. The converse satisfies every obligation. Finite-map verification gives membership in \(\#\mathsf{P}\); the non-affine Boolean relation \(\operatorname{NAE}_3\) is \(\#\mathsf{P}\)-complete by the Creignou--Hermann dichotomy. Exhaustive small-instance replay matches the exact counts.

value.rationale: The theorem extracts an exact enumerative invariant from a natural recent Jankov-frame reduction: the number of p-morphic witnesses equals a canonical Boolean model count. The parsimonious correspondence shows that exact modal quotient counting is already \(\#\mathsf{P}\)-complete on extremely simple rooted acyclic incidence frames. This is a structural and reusable counting fact, not a numerical recomputation or arbitrary finite slice.
